description: Open one part of the evidence map: a list (practices, cases, studies, figures, claim-checks, assessments) with filters such as theme, outcome, industry, company size, stage, priority, figure group (line) or assessment kind. Returns every matching row in one line with its id, or, when there are more than 25, a menu splitting them by the next filter, with counts. Use the arguments the menus show. Then fetch the rows you pick with get_evidence.

industry.description: Cases in this industry: professional-services, agencies, ecommerce-retail, manufacturing, or other (none of the four, e.g. banks, airlines, public bodies). Practices apply to all industries.

kind.description: Figures: the kind of number, e.g. measured-in-a-study or self-reported. Assessments: the kind key from start, e.g. readiness-surveys.

line.description: Figures only: the group key from start, e.g. time-freed or running-cost.

list.description: Which list: practices, cases, studies, figures, claim-checks or assessments.

outcome.description: Cases with this outcome: measured, company-reported, went-wrong or walked-back.

size.description: Company size band: micro-small, medium, mid-market, enterprise (1–49, 50–249, 250–999, 1,000+ employees). Or pass employees instead.

stage.description: How far the company is: explore, adopt, redesign or run.

task.description: Cases only: the kind of work AI was used for, a task key from start, e.g. customer-service-and-support or legal-research-drafting-and-filings.

theme.description: A theme key from start, e.g. governance-and-risk or people-and-skills.

name: open
title: Open one part of the evidence map
